intro: Local food, utility, housing and benefits resources with phone numbers and hours. This page has no forms and keeps no record of what you look up. Hours change; call first when you can.
verified_note: Listings were gathered from public directories in August 2026; individual listings do not yet link to their source. If a number or time is wrong, telling us fixes it.

categories.title: Food

resources.name: Clark County Ecumenical Food Pantry
resources.what: Food pantry — third Tuesday of each month

categories.also: SNAP (food stamps) applications: Access.Arkansas.gov, or the DHS county office — one application covers the whole family.

categories.title: Light bill / utilities

resources.name: LIHEAP energy assistance (via CADC)
resources.what: Help paying electric and heating bills for qualifying households (Central Arkansas Development Council)
resources.address: Statewide LIHEAP line — they route you to the Clark County intake

categories.also: Some churches above also help with utility bills; ask when you call.

categories.title: Housing / rent

resources.name: Arkadelphia Housing Authority
resources.what: Public housing and Section 8 vouchers — serves all of Clark County

categories.also: Public housing and voucher programs keep waiting lists; call the housing authority for the current wait.

categories.title: SNAP, Medicaid, and other benefits

resources.name: Access Arkansas (DHS)
resources.what: One application for SNAP, Medicaid, and family supports — online, by phone, by mail, or in person at the county DHS office

categories.also: The county DHS office on Main Street can help you apply in person.

missing: Know a resource that belongs here — a church program, a fund, a person who helps? Tell the counter at Ozark Cleaners or send it through the question box. One correction helps every neighbor after you.
